import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline
sys.setrecursionlimit(10**6)

N = int(input())
G = [[] for i in range(N)]
for i in range(N-1):
	A, B = map(int, input().split())
	A -= 1
	B -= 1
	G[A].append(B)
	G[B].append(A)
K = int(input())
L = [-10**9] * N
R = [10**9] * N
for i in range(K):
	v, p = map(int, input().split())
	L[v] = p
	R[p] = v

import heapq

Q = [(-L[i], i) for i in range(N)]
heapq.heapify(Q)
flag = [0] * N
ans = [0] * N

while Q:
	d, v = heapq.heappop(Q)
	if flag[v]:
		continue
	flag[v] = 1
	ans[v] = d - 1
	for w in G[v]:
		if flag[w]:
			continue
		heapq.heappush(Q, (-(L[w] - L[v] + 1), w))

print('\n'.join(map(str, ans)))
